board.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone polished landscape Puff Trails Achievement Badge Collection SECTION BOARD, based on the achievement panel of the supplied master reference. Soft plush rounded fantasy mobile-game aesthetic; rich violet enamel, warm metallic gold, pink and cyan crystals, cream/lavender background, beautiful soft studio lighting. No characters at all. Large readable title 'Achievement Badge Collection'. Main content: precise clean grid of 8 rows and 5 columns, each badge separately spaced, all 40 badge designs visible. Columns Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Legendary. Rows and center emblem: First Win (single gold star), Perfect Clear (cyan faceted crystal), Big Pop (three colored round bubbles), Level Streak (calendar with check), Star Collector (star cluster), Treasure Hunter (purple gold chest), Event Champion (crown; visibly label 'Future concept'), Combo Master (warm flame). Each row keeps its emblem while frames evolve from simple bronze shield, silver shield, gold laurel shield, platinum violet crystal frame, to glorious winged gold legendary frame. At bottom concise text 'Visual tiers only • Unlock rules and thresholds remain configurable'. No numbers, no leaderboards, no rewards or prices. Preserve original reference design vocabulary without adding competitive gameplay. This is a section design board, not a sprite atlas; immaculate hierarchy and enough whitespace for all 40 badges and exact labels.
source_references: /Users/mac/Projects/Testing gpt project/boards/Puff Trails Achievement Mastery Showcase.png
board.qa: Visually inspected: 8 rows x5 tiers complete; correct readable labels; Event Champion Future concept; no characters or gameplay threshold changes.
board.postprocessing: AI logo replaced by exact locked main logo, resized without redrawing, over opaque lavender plaque.
board.final_asset_overlay: Final frame/emblem compositions overlaid in all40boardcells; exactlockedstar/gem/chest reused, so fullboardmatchesdeliveredassets.
